contradictions.title: Raw exit_code 1 vs declared failed=0
contradictions.root_cause: pytest returns exit_code=1 for the 1 pre-existing skill registry failure. Declaration counts it as skipped=1 rather than failed=1. The raw capture honestly recorded exit_code=1 but declaration misclassified the outcome.
contradictions.fix_description: generate_from_declaration() must cross-reference capture-meta.json exit_code when available

contradictions.title: Lane ledger TEST-EXECUTION exit_code=0 vs capture-meta exit_code=1
contradictions.root_cause: generate_from_declaration() computes exit_code from declaration's test_results.failed count (0=pass). It does not consult the actual capture-meta.json which recorded the real pytest exit_code=1.
contradictions.fix_description: generate_from_declaration() must read capture-meta.json and use its exit_code for TEST-EXECUTION lane

contradictions.title: Dirty git detector false clean despite M/?? files
contradictions.source_a: detect_dirty_git_state() output: is_dirty=false, recommendation='Git state is clean.'
contradictions.source_b: evidence-declaration.yaml: git_status_final='M tools/supervisor/anti_skip_checker.py, M tools/supervisor/grade_declared_work.py, ... ?? tools/supervisor/capture_raw_logs.py, ...'
contradictions.root_cause: detect_dirty_git_state() only checks for the word 'uncommitted' in git_status_final. The R107 declaration uses git-status-short format (M, ??) not the word 'uncommitted'. Detector always returns false for short-format status strings.
contradictions.fix_description: detect_dirty_git_state() must also detect M, ??, A, D, AM, R prefixes as dirty indicators

contradictions.title: Lane ledger entries have null command/exit_code/duration/artifacts for 10 of 11 lanes
contradictions.source_a: lane-execution-ledger.yaml: WAVE-0 through WAVE-9 all have command=null, exit_code=null, duration_seconds=null, artifacts=[]
contradictions.source_b: Evidence shows actual work was performed with real file creation
contradictions.root_cause: generate_from_declaration() maps planned_work_items to lanes but only populates artifacts from evidence_paths/test_references. No execution metadata (command, exit_code, duration) is recorded because these were manual coding lanes, not subprocess executions.
contradictions.fix_description: Lane ledger validator should flag null execution fields as warnings. For non-subprocess lanes, populate command with descriptive action and note the lane type.

contradictions.title: Prompt quality invalid but continuation=YES
contradictions.source_a: R107 prompt quality: advancement_lane FAIL (supervisor terms not recognized)
contradictions.root_cause: advancement_lane failure was not in critical_prompt_failures set. Prompt quality check ran before prompt generation (Step 3c vs Step 4).
contradictions.fix_description: ALREADY FIXED in first R108 sprint. advancement_lane added to critical_prompt_failures, prompt quality moved to Step 4b, NO_PROMPT_QUALITY_FAILURE state added.

contradictions.title: Lane ledger TEST-EXECUTION title inconsistent
contradictions.root_cause: R107 manually edited the title after generation. Not a code bug but a ledger was hand-modified without validation.
contradictions.fix_description: Informational only. Ledger validator should not enforce exact title match.

contradictions.title: source-change-diffs.patch says 'no diff available' for untracked files
contradictions.source_a: git diff cannot produce diffs for untracked (??) files
contradictions.source_b: R107 declares 3 new tools as changed_files (capture_raw_logs.py, lane_execution_ledger.py, generate_sample_outputs.py)
contradictions.root_cause: git diff only works on tracked files. Untracked files (marked with ??) have no prior version to diff against. The materialization step correctly identifies them but cannot produce diffs.
contradictions.fix_description: Changed-file materialization should use 'git diff /dev/null <file>' for untracked files to produce a full-content diff, or explicitly classify as NEW_FILE
